description: Long-pass blocking filters (GG, OG and RG coloured glass) in the Apache Point Observatory filter inventory.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical/infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in New Mexico, operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: Cut-on wavelengths, peak transmission and sizes are from the APO blocking-filter page (76 mm square filters).

GG385.Description: GG-385 long-pass blocking filter (APO lists cutoff 382 nm)

GG495.Description: GG-495 long-pass blocking filter (APO lists cutoff 499 nm)

OG530.Description: OG-530 long-pass blocking filter (APO lists cutoff 534 nm)

RG5.Description: RG-5 long-pass blocking filter (APO lists cutoff 668 nm)

RG610.Description: RG-610 long-pass blocking filter (APO lists cutoff 605 nm)
